Algumas mudanças só aparecem depois de s: Some changes only show up after signing out and back in to Windows.

Baixo: o Windows fica com visual mais si: Low: Windows gets a simpler look.
Coloca o serviço LMS em Desativado; o ti: Sets the LMS service to Disabled; the original type is saved for undo.
Coloca os efeitos visuais em \"Personali: Sets visual effects to "Custom" (VisualFXSetting = 3) and turns off MinAnimate, TaskbarAnimations, ListviewAlphaSelect, ListviewShadow and EnableAeroPeek. Font smoothing (FontSmoothing) is not changed.
Desativa o serviço Intel Local Managemen: Disables the Intel Local Management Service, used only for corporate remote management (Intel AMT/vPro). It only shows up if the service exists and the PC is not on a domain.
Desfazer remove o valor (o Windows volta: Undo removes the value (Windows goes back to local time).
Desliga animações de janelas e da barra: Turns off window and taskbar animations, shadows and selection transparency, keeping font smoothing.
Em PCs de empresa gerenciados remotament: On remotely managed company PCs, don't disable it.
Faz o Windows tratar o relógio da placa-: Makes Windows treat the motherboard clock as UTC, like Linux. Avoids the wrong time when switching between Windows and Linux.
Grava RealTimeIsUniversal = 1 em TimeZon: Writes RealTimeIsUniversal = 1 in TimeZoneInformation. Linux uses UTC in the hardware clock by default and Windows uses local time; with this tweak both agree.
Grava a política DisableFileSyncNGSC = 1: Writes the DisableFileSyncNGSC = 1 policy ("Prevent the usage of OneDrive for file storage").
The right time on both systems.
Interface mais rápida em PCs fracos. Em: Faster interface on weak PCs. On modern PCs the effect on games is practically zero.

Duas opções separadas para o OneDrive: a: Two separate options for OneDrive: the sync policy (above, reversible) and uninstalling via winget (here, Medium risk, with double confirmation; undo reinstalls it).
